metric_expectations.source_text: Out-of-sample Sharpe ≥ 1.0 net of modeled costs.
DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count.
Max drawdown ≤ 20% in any walk-forward fold.
Parameter sensitivity: ±25% parameter shift keeps Sharpe within 70% of baseline.

realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-12aq / WP-S2c-8 uses the final local data-year evaluation window, 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11, as the first additional H-001 D2 observation after the original full-period no-formal-split baseline. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-001 REP-0002 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this package follows the later repo precedent of explicit non-cloned window disclosure for additional REP evidence.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: D2-006 requires out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0016 records sharpe below that threshold.
D2-006 requires DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count; OL-0016 records dsr below that threshold.
D2-006 requires max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold; OL-0016 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
D2-006 requires parameter sensitivity min_ratio >= 0.70; OL-0016 records sensitivity_min_ratio below that threshold.
D2-006 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0016 records walk_forward_efficiency below that threshold.

interpretation: REC-0027 derives from OL-0016 and is the WP-S2c-10 H-001 d2_006_gates cycle 1 REC for the A2C-001 first-member runway.
